Move files into a governed lifecycle

Sending a file through the DMS boundary gives it hierarchy, metadata, versioning and access context. Bypassing that boundary may store bytes, but it loses the operational guarantees that make the content manageable later.

Use the integration guidance below to hand content to the document domain rather than creating parallel storage conventions.
